errors.evidence: The pie chart and reference description show six categories, not five.

errors.evidence: This is presented as a category, but the description still says there are only five categories; the figure includes this sixth category as a separate legend entry and slice.
The green slice for "От 16 до 30 години" is labeled 13.6%, not about 7%.
The purple slice for "Над 30 години" is about 4.5% (one of the small slices), not about 7%.

errors.text_span: Секторът "От 6 до 15 години" е най-голям, заемайки приблизително 36,4% от цялото
errors.evidence: The largest sector is not uniquely "От 6 до 15 години"; it is tied with "От 1 до 5 години" at 36.4% each.

errors.text_span: Размерите на секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ ред.
errors.evidence: The pie slices are not arranged in strict descending order around the chart; the two 36.4% slices are adjacent and the smaller slices follow, but the overall ordering is not clearly a simple descending sequence.
The description omits that the chart contains a legend and that the percentages are displayed inside the slices, both noted in the reference and visible in the figure.
